_hand: HAND-WRITTEN — the one registry entry that does NOT come from daedalus's Apply flow. Same entry schema as one apps.json value, read by daedalus.nix through platform/lib/registry-lib.nix — with ONE difference: where a registry entry carries a full `hostname`, this file carries `hostLabel`, and daedalus.nix joins it to the site's baseDomain before the mapper or the manifest see it, so the engine never spells a domain. daedalus is declared here rather than in the registry because an Apply that broke its entry would take down the interface you would use to undo it. Editing this file IS the workflow; rebuild to apply. The label overrides the derived default because the bare `daedalus` label is reserved (daedalus.nix, reservedLabels: the project's public landing page, a hand-managed CNAME to GitHub Pages) — the app takes daedalus-app so the two names never collide anywhere: pi-hole, traefik, or the tunnel's route-sync.

notes.app: The control plane itself. Declared by hand in stacks/daedalus/self.json rather than in the registry: an Apply that broke this entry would take down the interface you would use to undo it.
notes.source: The engine itself: one image from the repository's Dockerfile. A host on the published image runs its bundle; the host that develops the engine runs it in dev mode (fleet.daedalus.dev) over its checkout, where saving a file is the whole deploy.
